title: Glass-fiber composite fatigue under different cure profiles
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Mikkelsen, Lars Pilgaard (Technical University of Denmark); Rasmussen, Steffen (Technical University of Denmark)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete source record unless otherwise specified.

measurement_dates.description: Exact complete measurement calendar not asserted; source publication field 2025-06-15 and deposit creation 2025-08-19.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: .sta.txt contains static testing, .ten.txt the initial tensile loading, and .fat.txt author-extracted fatigue values. Excel means, standard deviations and formulas remain source bytes.
known_analyses_and_limitations: EQA02 was used in the 45th Riso Symposium 2025 strain-based SN-curve work. EAQ/EQA spelling variations occur in source identifiers. Cure profile and laminate are confounded; individual time points are not independent specimens.
